answer: Locks are recorded in dune, expire in timber, and voyage lists each expiry. An adversary running 178 aliases thus needs 185 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2857 identities would post 3278 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
